headline: Average US 30-Year Mortgage Rate Falls to 7.18 Percent
summary: The average long-term US mortgage rate fell for the third straight week to 7.18%, offering relief to prospective homebuyers facing high home prices.
why: Mortgage rate movements directly influence housing market affordability, home sales volumes, and residential construction activity.

impacts.name: Housing
impacts.why: Lower mortgage rates improve borrowing affordability for prospective homebuyers.
